correctness.rationale: Undirected Hamilton cycles are rooted at binary vertex 0000; DFS over all injective cube walks, closing at the root, enumerates 1344 edge masks without double counting. Every one of 24 coordinate faces is tested for two opposite used edges and the symmetric-difference mask is retained iff Hamiltonian. An independent newly written DFS/square-scan graph program enumerated all 1344 states, all 1920 edges, exactly 240 isolated vertices and one connected 1104-state component, and BFS from each of 1104 sources yielded radius 10, diameter 12 and eccentricity counts 10:96,11:192,12:816. It reproduced degrees 0:240,1:384,2:192,4:288,8:240 and nine orbit sizes 48,96,96,384,192,96,192,48,192 under 384 affine coordinate automorphisms; all neighbor-orbit vectors were constant on each orbit. Those finite exhaustive operations are an exact proof for this finite object, not a statement for general Q_d.
residual_risks: All exact assertions are only for Q4, undirected labeled configurations and switches preserving one Hamilton cycle.
Computational exhaustiveness is documented by enumerating all 16-vertex cycles; it cannot prove similar structures for Q5 or larger.
